parameters.name: Area
parameters.description:
The acceleration region in which you want to prefetch content. If you do not specify a region, the value overseas is used.

*   **domestic**: Chinese mainland
*   **overseas**: outside the Chinese mainland

parameters.name: L2Preload
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to prefetch content to POPs. Valid values:

*   **true**: prefetches content to nodes that include L2 DCDN nodes.
*   **false**: prefetches content to L2 POPs or L3 POPs.

parameters.name: ObjectPath
parameters.description: The path of the content that you want to prefetch. Separate multiple URLs with line feed characters (\n) or a pair of carriage return and line feed characters (\r\n).

parameters.name: WithHeader
parameters.description: The custom header for prefetch in the JSON format.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dcdn preload-dcdn-object-caches --object-path http://example.com/examplefile.txt_http://example.com/examplefile2.txt --area domestic --l2-preload true --with-header Accept-Encoding_:_gzip --query-hashkey true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dcdn PreloadDcdnObjectCaches --region cn-hangzhou --QueryHashkey true --ObjectPath 'http://example.com/examplefile.txt_http://example.com/examplefile2.txt' --Area domestic --WithHeader 'Accept-Encoding_:_gzip' --L2Preload true
